title: Doc comments the dashboard rewrite falsified
body:
watch.go:57-64 and Long help promise exit 5 for an interrupted watch (never returned); run_test.go:448 says Ctrl-C cancels the context (raw mode makes it a key); status_model.go:381-385 and 523-527 say the dashboard readers 'answer nil' / are 'nil-safe stubs'; build.go:196-198 'the one dashboards datum this tick computes for real'; statusmodel.go:29-34 'pinned by contract.json in this package … only Go reads it today'; watch_block_test.go:107 'events worth remembering kept above the block'.
evidence: internal/cli/watch.go:57-64; internal/statusmodel/statusmodel.go:29-34; internal/statusmodel/build.go:196-198; internal/cli/status_model.go:381-385
